# **1. Purchase Request (PR)**

## **1.1 Purpose / Use Case**

The Requestor flow enables department staff to create, edit, and submit Purchase Requests (PR) for procurement of goods and services. The Requestor initiates the 6-stage PR approval workflow by preparing and submitting a PR document that will be reviewed and approved by subsequent roles.

### **Workflow Context**

| **Stage** | **Role** | **Action** |
|-|-|-|
| 1 | Requestor | Create & Submit PR (this document) |
| 2 | HOD (Head of Department) | Review & Approve Quantity |
| 3 | Purchase Officer | Vendor Allocation & Submit |
| 4 | FC (Financial Controller) | Financial Approval |
| 5 | GM (General Manager) | Management Approval |
| 6 | Owner | Final Approval |

This document covers Stage 1 only. Other stages are documented in their respective flow documents (BL-FLOW-002 through BL-FLOW-004).

### **Access Path**

The Requestor accesses the PR module via:

1. Login → Dashboard (BL-PAGE-007) — shows greeting, pending PR counts, and recent PR list
2. Dashboard → Side nav "Procurement" → Procurement Landing (BL-PAGE-008)
3. Procurement Landing → Click "Purchase Request" card → PR List Screen (BL-PAGE-001)

### **Flow Summary**

| **Step** | **Action** | **Screen** |
|-|-|-|
| 1 | Log in | Dashboard |
| 2 | Navigate to Procurement | Procurement Landing |
| 3 | View PR List | PR List (BL-PAGE-001) |
| 4 | Click "+ Add Request" → Blank PR or PR Template | Create Dialog |
| 5 | Fill PR header and add line items | PR Create Form (BL-PAGE-002) |
| 6 | Add items via product search | Item Search (BL-MODAL-001) |
| 7 | Save as Draft or Submit for approval | PR Create Form |
| 8 | View submitted PR | PR Detail (BL-PAGE-003) |

## **1.3 Using the "Add Request" Button to Create a Purchase Request**

**Access Path:** PR List (BL-PAGE-001) → Click "+ Add Request" → Select "Blank PR" or "PR Template"
**Route (Create):** `/procurement/purchase-request/new`

*Figure 4: Create Purchase Request Dialog*
![](data:image/png;base64,)

The Requestor may start from a blank form or from a PR Template. If a template is selected via BL-MODAL-002, the form is pre-filled with the template's workflow, description, and line items.

*Figure 16: PR Create Form — Empty (BL-PAGE-002)*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


### **1.3.1 Document Creation Format**

The PR Create form collects header information, summary totals (calculated), and line item details.

#### **1.3.1.1 Header Information**

| **Field** | **Required** | **Description** | **Format** | **Default Value** | **Business Logic / Remark** |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Date | Y | PR creation date | Date picker (YYYY-MM-DD) | Today | Auto-populated with today. Editable. |
| Requester | Y | Person creating the PR | Text (read-only) | Logged-in user | Auto-populated from logged-in user. Read-only. |
| Department | Y | Requester department | Text (read-only) | From user profile | Auto-populated from user profile. Read-only. |
| Workflow | Y | PR workflow type | Dropdown | (none — must select) | Dropdown: Asset, General, Market List. Determines approval routing. |
| Description | N | Free text description of the request | Text area | | Optional. Multi-line. |

*Figure 17: Workflow Dropdown Options*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


#### **1.3.1.2 Summary Information**

Summary row appears at the bottom of the items grid after items are added:

| **Field** | **Description** | **Calculation Formula** |
|-|-|-|
| Sub-Total | Total before discount and tax | Sum of (Requested × Unit Price) for all line items |
| Discount | Total discount amount | Sum of per-line discounts (if applicable) |
| Base Amount | Amount after discount | Sub-Total − Discount |
| Tax (VAT) | Tax amount | Per tax profile settings |
| Total | Final PR amount | Base Amount + Tax |

> ⚠️ **PRD Note (FR-PR-023 — Planned)**: PRD v1.9.0 proposes removing summary totals from Requestor view during PR creation. Requestors would focus on line items only; totals visible during approval stages. Currently the summary row is visible in the live app. This is a pending change — needs Product Owner sign-off.

*Figure 32: Items Grid with Subtotal Row — BL-PAGE-003*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


#### **1.3.1.3 Detail Information (Items)**

The items grid displays all line items on the PR. The Requestor adds, edits, and removes line items from this grid.

| **Column** | **Required** | **Description** | **Format** | **Default** | **Business Logic / Remark** |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| # | - | Row sequence number | Integer | Auto | Auto-incremented |
| Location | Y | Delivery/storage location | Dropdown (code) | | E.g., 1FB02, 3FB05. Shows INVENTORY/DIRECT badge. |
| Product | Y | Product to request | Search dropdown | | Opens BL-MODAL-001. Shows product code + name. |
| Requested | Y | Requested quantity | Number (3 decimal) | 1 | Must be > 0. 3 decimal places (BR-PR-023). |
| Amount | N | Unit price / total amount | Number (2 decimal) | — | ⚠️ PRD (FR-PR-011A): Unit Price should be hidden from Requestors. Verify in live app. |
| Currency | Y | Currency for this line item | Dropdown | THB | Available to Requestors (BR-PR-102). Default: THB. |
| Delivery Point | N | Specific delivery location | Dropdown | | From DeliveryPoint master data (FR-PR-022). Typeahead. |
| Delivery Date | Y | Required delivery date | Date picker | | Must be >= today (BR-PR-016). |

Grid actions:

| **Button** | **Description** | **Business Logic** |
|-|-|-|
| + Add Item | Adds a new blank row | Inserts row with empty fields. User must fill Location + Product. |
| Delete Row (x) | Removes selected line item | Available per row. No confirmation dialog observed. |

*Figure 18: Location Dropdown with Codes*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


##### **1.3.1.3.1 Adding Items to the Document**

To add a line item, the Requestor:
1. Clicks "+ Add Item" to insert a new row
2. Selects a **Location** from the dropdown (required before product search)
3. Clicks the **Product** field to open the Item Search (BL-MODAL-001)
4. Searches for and selects a product
5. Fills in **Requested** quantity, **Delivery Date**, and optional fields

###### **1.3.1.3.1.1 Part 1: Product Information**

The Item Search (BL-MODAL-001) is an inline search dropdown within the line item row. It is not a separate modal window.

**Trigger:** Click Product field on a line item row (Location must be selected first)

| **Element** | **Description** |
|-|-|
| Search input | Free text search by product code or product name. Real-time (debounced). |
| Location filter | Auto-applied — results filtered to the selected Location on the parent row |
| Product Code column | Numeric code (e.g., 11130023) |
| Product Name column | Full product name (may include Thai characters) |
| Selection | Single-click on row selects product and closes dropdown |

*Figure 21: Product Search Dropdown*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


###### **1.3.1.3.1.2 Part 2: Summary (Value & Currency)**

After a product is selected, the line item row shows summary value fields:

| **Field** | **Auto-populated From** | **Editable** |
|-|-|-|
| Unit | Product master default unit of measure | No (read-only) |
| Currency | Default (THB) | Yes — Requestor can change (BR-PR-102) |
| Amount | — | ⚠️ Verify: PRD says hidden from Requestors (FR-PR-011A) |

###### **1.3.1.3.1.3 Part 3: Product on Stock**

⚠ ***ASSUMED — Not verified by live testing***

When a product is selected, the system may surface stock-on-hand data:

| **Information** | **Description** |
|-|-|
| Current stock level | Quantity currently in inventory for the selected location |
| Last ordered quantity | Most recent quantity ordered for this product |

> Note: Stock data display in the Requestor search view was not explicitly confirmed in live testing. Verify in live app.

###### **1.3.1.3.1.4 Part 4: Apply Last Price**

⚠ ***ASSUMED — Not verified by live testing***

The system may provide a "Last Price" reference for the selected product:

| **Information** | **Description** |
|-|-|
| Last purchase price | Most recent unit price paid for this product |
| Apply Last Price action | Allows Requestor to populate the Amount field with the last known price |

> Note: Per PRD (FR-PR-011A), Unit Price is defined as hidden from Requestors. If this is enforced, the Apply Last Price feature may not be available to Requestors. Verify in live app.

###### **1.3.1.3.1.5 Part 5: Action Buttons**

| **Action** | **Result** |
|-|-|
| Click product row | Selects product; dropdown closes; product populated on line item |
| Click outside dropdown | Dropdown closes; no change to line item |
| Press Escape | Dropdown closes; no change to line item |

**Auto-population on product selection:**

| **Field** | **Pre-populated From** |
|-|-|
| Product (display) | Product name from product master |
| Product Code (hidden) | Product code from product master |

### **1.3.2 Saving the Document**
The Requestor can save the PR as a Draft or submit it immediately.

#### **Action Buttons**

| **Button**     | **Color**      | **Description**            | **Business Logic**                                                                                     |
| -------------- | -------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Save           | Secondary      | Saves PR as Draft          | Validates required header fields. Status = DRAFT.                                                      |
| Change Request | Primary (Blue) | Submits PR for approval    | Validates all required fields + at least 1 line item. Status → IN PROGRESS. Advances to Stage 2 (HOD). |
| Print          | Secondary      | Opens browser print dialog | Native print dialog for current form                                                                   |

#### **Toast Notifications on Save**

| **Action**        | **Toast Message**                           | **Type**        | **Duration** |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------ |
| Save new PR       | "Purchase Request created successfully"     | Success (green) | ~3 seconds   |
| Save existing PR  | "Purchase Request updated successfully"     | Success (green) | ~3 seconds   |
| Submit PR         | No toast — redirects to success result page | —               | N/A          |
| API error on save | "Failed to save purchase request"           | Error (red)     | ~5 seconds   |

#### **Navigation After Save**

| **Action**                        | **Destination**                          |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Save (success)                    | BL-PAGE-003 (PR Detail) or stays on form |
| Submit / Change Request (success) | BL-PAGE-003 (PR Detail)                  |
| Cancel / Back                     | BL-PAGE-001 (PR List)                    |

#### **Cancel Button Behaviour**

The Cancel button on the Create/Edit form navigates directly back to PR List (BL-PAGE-001) WITHOUT a confirmation dialog, even if the form has unsaved changes. Verified: selecting a workflow type and clicking Cancel — no "Unsaved changes" warning appeared.

#### **Edge Cases & Error States (Create Form)**

⚠ ***ASSUMED — Not verified by live testing***

| **#** | **Scenario** | **System Behaviour** |
|-|-|-|
| 1 | Required field left blank on Submit | Inline error below field. Form does not submit. |
| 2 | No line items on Submit | "Please add at least one item" error message |
| 3 | Session expired mid-edit | Redirect to login. Unsaved data lost. |
| 4 | Duplicate product on different lines | Allowed — each row is independent |
| 5 | API error on save | Error toast: "Failed to save purchase request" |
| 6 | User navigates away with unsaved changes | No confirmation dialog — unsaved changes lost silently |
| 7 | Requested qty = 0 | Validation error: quantity must be > 0 |
| 8 | Delivery date in the past | PRD (BR-PR-016): future date required. Verify if live app enforces. |

## **1.4 Editing the Purchase Request**

Editing is available only on PRs with status = **DRAFT** (or VOID per FR-PR-011). Once submitted (IN PROGRESS), the PR is read-only for the Requestor.

**Access Path:** PR Detail (BL-PAGE-003) → Click "Edit" button (visible on DRAFT status only)
**Route:** `/procurement/purchase-request/:uuid/edit`

### **1.4.1 Editing Various Fields**

In Edit mode, the PR Create form reopens with all saved data pre-populated. The Requestor can modify any editable field.

| **Behaviour** | **Create Mode** | **Edit Mode** |
|-|-|-|
| PR Number | Not shown (assigned on first save) | Shown, read-only |
| URL | /procurement/purchase-request/new | /procurement/purchase-request/:uuid/edit |
| Header fields | Auto-populated defaults | Pre-populated from saved data |
| Items grid | Empty | Pre-populated with saved line items |
| Availability | Always (with create permission) | Status = DRAFT, VOID, or Returned (FR-PR-011) |
| Submit button | Available after save | Available |

All fields editable in Create mode remain editable in Edit mode. The Requester and Department fields remain read-only in both modes.

> ⚠️ **VOID Edit (FR-PR-011)**: PRD states Requestors should have full edit capability on VOID PRs. Not verified in live app — needs testing.

### **1.4.2 Deleting Items from PR**

#### **Delete a Line Item (Row)**

The Requestor can remove individual line items from the items grid:

- Click the Delete (x) icon on the row
- No confirmation dialog observed for row deletion
- Row removed immediately from the grid

#### **Delete the Entire PR**

✓ ***VERIFIED — Confirmed via Playwright live testing***

The Requestor can delete an entire Draft PR from the PR Detail page:

| **Property** | **Value** |
|-|-|
| Trigger | Click "Delete" button (red) on PR Detail page — status = DRAFT only |
| Dialog Type | AlertDialog (modal, blocks background) |
| Title | "Delete Purchase Request" |
| Message | "Are you sure you want to delete \"{PR ID}\"? This action cannot be undone." |
| Cancel Button | Secondary (white). Closes dialog. No action taken. |
| Delete Button | Destructive (red). Permanently deletes the PR. |
| On success | Navigates back to PR List (BL-PAGE-001). PR removed from list. |

## **1.5 Confirming / Submitting the Purchase Request**

✓ ***VERIFIED — Confirmed via Playwright live testing***

The Requestor submits a Draft PR by clicking the "Submit" button on the PR Detail page, or "Change Request" on the Create/Edit form.

### **Submit Confirmation Dialog**

Triggered when the Requestor clicks "Submit" on a Draft PR with at least one line item.

| **Property** | **Value** |
|-|-|
| Dialog Type | AlertDialog (modal, blocks background) |
| Title | "Submit Purchase Request" |
| Message | "This will submit the PR for approval. Are you sure?" |
| Cancel Button | Secondary (white). Closes dialog. No action taken. |
| Submit Button | Primary (blue). Submits PR. Status → IN PROGRESS. Advances to HOD stage. |
| On success | Page reloads showing IN PROGRESS status. Workflow stages updated. Success result page displayed. |

*Figure 28: Submit Purchase Request Confirmation Dialog*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


### **Status Transitions**

⚠ ***ASSUMED — Not verified by live testing***

| **From Status** | **Action** | **To Status** | **Stage Transition** |
|-|-|-|-|
| (new) | Save | DRAFT | None — stays at Requestor |
| DRAFT | Submit | IN PROGRESS | Stage 1 → Stage 2 (HOD) |
| DRAFT | Cancel | CANCEL | None — workflow terminates |
| IN PROGRESS (sent back) | Re-submit | IN PROGRESS | Returns to the stage that sent it back |
| VOID | Edit | VOID | No status change while editing |
| VOID | Re-submit | IN PROGRESS | Returns to approval workflow at Stage 2 (HOD) |

### **Workflow History Entry**

| **Action** | **history.action value** | **Notes** |
|-|-|-|
| Requestor creates PR | create | Status = DRAFT |
| Requestor submits PR | submit | Displayed as "WF SUBMITTED". Status → IN PROGRESS. |
| Requestor re-submits (after send-back) | resubmit | PR moves back into approval workflow |
| Requestor cancels PR | cancel | Status → CANCEL. Only for DRAFT PRs. |

## **1.6 Workflow Operations**

### **1.6.1 Workflow Overview (from Requestor Perspective)**

After submission, the Requestor's role is to monitor the PR as it moves through the 6-stage approval workflow. The Requestor does not perform any approval actions — those are handled by HOD, Purchase Officer, FC, GM, and Owner roles (documented in BL-FLOW-002 through BL-FLOW-004).

From the Requestor's perspective, the workflow involves:

| **Scenario** | **What the Requestor Sees / Does** |
|-|-|
| PR submitted | Status = IN PROGRESS. PR is read-only. Workflow stage progress indicator visible on PR Detail. |
| PR approved at a stage | Stage progress indicator advances. Requestor notified (FR-PR-014 — Planned). |
| PR fully approved | Status = APPROVED. |
| PR returned by an approver | PR returns to Stage 1 (Requestor). Status stays IN PROGRESS but PR becomes editable again. Return reason visible in Workflow History. |
| PR rejected / void | Status = VOID or CANCEL. Requestor notified. |

The Requestor monitors their PR queue via:
- **Dashboard** (BL-PAGE-007): "My Pending" cards show PR counts
- **PR List** (BL-PAGE-001): Filter by status/stage to find PRs needing action
- **My Approval** (BL-PAGE-009): Shows PRs returned to the Requestor for revision

### **1.6.2 Side Bar View — My Approval (BL-PAGE-009)**

The My Approval page shows all procurement documents pending the current user's action across all document types. For the Requestor, this primarily shows PRs that have been returned for revision.

**Route:** `/procurement/approval`

### **1.6.3 Full Page View — PR Detail (BL-PAGE-003)**

The PR Detail page is the full read-only view of a submitted PR. It shows the PR header, line items, current approval stage progress, and full workflow history.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**Access Path:** PR List (BL-PAGE-001) → Click PR number, or after Submit from BL-PAGE-002

#### **Header Information**

| **Field**       | **Description**           | **Remark**                                             |
| --------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| PR Number       | Unique PR identifier      | Format: PR{YYYY}{MM}{NNNNN}                            |
| Status Badge    | Current document status   | Color-coded                                            |
| Date            | PR creation date          | YYYY-MM-DD                                             |
| Requester       | Creator name              |                                                        |
| Department      | Requester department      |                                                        |
| Description     | PR description text       |                                                        |
| Workflow Stages | Visual progress indicator | Checkmarks for completed, active highlight for current |

> ⚠️ **Note:** The Progress shows HOD Complete - Current /Create request - Next / HOD

#### **Summary Information**

| **Field** | **Description** | **Calculation** |
|-|-|-|
| Sub-Total | Total before adjustments | Sum of line item amounts |
| Discount | Discount amount | Per-line or document-level |
| Base Amount | Amount after discount | Sub-Total − Discount |
| Tax | Tax amount (VAT) | Per tax profile |
| Total | Final document total | Base Amount + Tax |

#### **Detail Information — Items Tab**

| **Column** | **Description** | **Remark** |
|-|-|-|
| # | Row number | Auto-numbered |
| Banquet | Location/banquet assignment | From line item location |
| Product | Product name | From product master |
| Requested | Requested quantity | Quantity entered by Requestor |
| Approved | Approved quantity | Set by HOD in Stage 2. Blank until approved. |
| Qty | Final quantity | May differ from Requested after approval |
| Unit | Unit of measure | E.g., EA, KG, BTL |
| Currency | Currency code | E.g., THB |

#### **Workflow History Tab**

The Workflow History tab shows a vertical timeline of all actions taken on the PR:

| **Column** | **Description** |
|-|-|
| Date/Time | Timestamp (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) |
| Action Label | Action type badge (e.g., WF SUBMITTED, WF REVIEWED) |
| Stage Info | Stage transition (e.g., "HOD > Create Request") |
| User | Name of person who performed the action |
| Role | Role label |

Events displayed in reverse chronological order (most recent at top).

*Figure 20: PR Detail — Workflow History Tab*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


#### **Button State by Status**

| **Status**  | **Edit Button**             | **Delete Button** | **Submit Button** | **Comment Button** |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- | ------------------ |
| DRAFT       | Visible (blue)              | Visible (red)     | Visible (blue)    | Visible            |
| IN PROGRESS | Hidden                      | Hidden            | Hidden            | Visible            |
| APPROVED    | Hidden                      | Hidden            | Hidden            | Visible            |
| DONE        | Hidden                      | Hidden            | Hidden            | Visible            |
| CANCEL      | Hidden                      | Hidden            | Hidden            | Visible            |
| VOID        | ⚠️ TBD — Verify (FR-PR-011) | Hidden            | Hidden            | Visible            |

#### **Document Status Codes**

| **Status** | **Badge Colour** | **Description** |
|-|-|-|
| DRAFT | White / Gray | Created but not submitted. Editable by Requestor. |
| IN PROGRESS | Yellow | In approval workflow. Read-only for Requestor. |
| APPROVED | Green | All approval stages completed. |
| DONE | Green | Converted to PO or fully processed. |
| CANCEL | Red | Cancelled. |
| VOID | Gray | Voided after submission. |

> **PRD Mapping Notes:**
> - "DONE" (this doc) = "Completed" (PRD v1.9.0) — PR converted to Purchase Order(s).
> - "CANCEL" (this doc) = "Cancelled" (PRD v1.9.0) — manually cancelled.
> - **VOID Semantic Mismatch**: Doc uses VOID=Gray (administrative). PRD uses Void=Red (approval denied). ⚠️ Verify with Product Owner.
> - **Returned**: Not a separate status. When returned by approver, PR stays IN PROGRESS but regresses to Requestor stage for revision.

### **1.6.4 Returned PR — Re-editing and Re-submitting**

(FR-PR-005A — Planned)

When an Approver returns a PR to the Requestor:

1. PR status remains **IN PROGRESS** but regresses to Stage 1 (Requestor stage).
2. Requestor sees the PR as editable again (equivalent to Draft editing capability).
3. Return reason / comment visible in the Workflow History tab.
4. Requestor edits the PR to address the feedback, then re-submits.
5. On re-submit: PR advances back to the stage that returned it.
6. Bulk action "Set Date Required" available on Returned PRs (FR-PR-026).

### **1.6.5 Cancellation**

The Requestor can cancel a **Draft** PR:

| **Property** | **Value** |
|-|-|
| Available status | DRAFT only |
| Trigger | "Cancel" action on PR Detail (not the form Cancel button) |
| Resulting status | CANCEL |
| Reversible | No — once cancelled, the PR cannot be reactivated |

### **1.6.6 Viewing the PR Document (Row Actions)**

The PR List (BL-PAGE-001) row actions context menu is triggered by clicking the three-dot (ellipsis) menu icon in the Actions column.

*Figure 31: Row Actions Context Menu on PR List*
![](data:image/png;base64,)


| **Menu Item** | **Icon** | **Description** | **Condition** |
|-|-|-|-|
| Approve | Checkmark (green) | Quick approve from list | PR at stage where current user can approve |
| Reject | X mark (red) | Quick reject from list | PR at stage where current user can reject |

For the Requestor persona, these actions may appear when a PR is at the "Create Request" stage and has been sent back for revision.

# **Appendix D — Business Rules**

⚠ ***ASSUMED — Not verified by live testing***

| **#** | **Rule**                            | **Detail**                                                                                                                |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1     | Required fields on Submit           | Date, Requester, Department, Workflow type, at least 1 line item with Location + Product + Qty + Delivery Date            |
| 2     | Requestor can only edit DRAFT PRs   | Once submitted (IN PROGRESS), PR is read-only for Requestor                                                               |
| 3     | PR number assignment                | Generated on first save. Format: PR{YYYY}{MM}{NNNNN}                                                                      |
| 4     | BU scope                            | PRs are scoped to the selected Business Unit                                                                              |
| 5     | Department auto-assignment          | Auto-filled from Requestor user profile. Cannot be changed.                                                               |
| 6     | Workflow determines approval chain  | Asset / General / Market List each route through different approval sequences                                             |
| 7     | Line item quantity validation       | Requested quantity must be > 0                                                                                            |
| 8     | Location required before Product    | Product search filtered by Location. Location must be selected first.                                                     |
| 9     | Decimal precision                   | Quantities: 3 decimal places (BR-PR-023). Amounts/prices: 2 decimal places (BR-PR-022).                                   |
| 10    | Delivery date must be future        | PRD (BR-PR-016): Delivery date must be >= today. Verify if live app enforces.                                             |
| 11    | Requestor cannot see pricing fields | Per [[FR-PR-011A : Vendor, Unit Price, Discount, Tax Profile, FOC Quantity, Exchange Rate hidden. ⚠️ Verify Amount field. |
| 12    | Currency selector at creation       | Requestors can select transaction currency at item level (BR-PR-102). Default: THB.                                       |
| 13    | VOID PRs editable by Requestor      | PRD (FR-PR-011): Full edit on VOID PRs. ⚠️ Needs live app verification.                                                   |
| 14    | Header totals hidden (planned)      | PRD (FR-PR-023 — Planned): Requestor view should not show summary totals during creation.                                 |
| 15    | Bulk item actions for Requestor     | PRD (FR-PR-026): Requestors can select items + use "Set Date Required" in Draft, VOID, Returned PRs.                      |

# **Appendix G — Edge Cases & Error States (Flow-Level)**

| 3 | Edit a submitted (IN PROGRESS) PR | Not allowed; edit button hidden |

| 6 | Session expires during form fill | Redirect to login; unsaved data lost |
| 7 | BU switch while PR form is open | Not tested — unsaved data likely lost |
| 8 | PR sent back by HOD | Status stays IN PROGRESS but returns to Requestor stage for revision |
